labels.label: engine
labels.caption: A Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) flat-six revs and crackles. Same engine family as the 992 GT3 R, but this is not a 4.2-litre 992 GT3 R race-engine recording, and the slice is a mid-session rev, not a cold start.

labels.label: wing
labels.caption: An air whoosh, for airflow over the swan-neck rear wing.

labels.label: wheels
labels.caption: A car tyre squeal / skid, for the centre-lock wheels and slicks. A general tyre-squeal loop, not a recorded GT3 R slick.

labels.label: brakes
labels.caption: A hard scrape across rough stone, used as a stand-in for race brakes. Not a recorded steel or carbon disc.

labels.label: carbon
labels.caption: The same air whoosh, for air over the carbon-fibre body panels.

labels.label: cockpit
labels.caption: A workshop ratchet, used as a stand-in for a racing sequential gearshift in the cockpit. Not a recorded Porsche sequential gearbox.

labels.label: lights
labels.caption: A light-switch click, for the LED headlights.

labels.label: radiator
labels.caption: An industrial ventilation fan, used as a stand-in for air through the central radiator. Not a car radiator fan.

labels.label: fuel
labels.caption: Water being poured from bottles, used as a liquid-fill stand-in for the quick-fill fuel cell. Not a racing fuel-hose recording.

labels.label: debut
labels.caption: A longer mid-level slice of the same 991 GT3 RS exhaust recording, for the Daytona 2023 race debut. This is not pit-lane or Daytona atmosphere.

ambient.caption: A quiet loop taken from the same Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) exhaust recording, under the object page once sound is enabled. Not a pit-lane atmosphere recording.

ui.caption: A short UI tick for hovering a label. Optional — hook only if it feels right, and debounce it.

credits.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) - engine and exhaust sound (YouTube otznJ2rBoks)
credits.author: Automotion Media (YouTube)
credits.note: A 5.8-second mid-recording rev (about 10.5–16.3 s) with a hard, crackly lift. This is a road-going Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) naturally aspirated flat-six, not the 4.2-litre 992 GT3 R race engine.

credits.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) - engine and exhaust sound (YouTube otznJ2rBoks)
credits.author: Automotion Media (YouTube)
credits.note: A 7.2-second mid-level exhaust slice (about 40.0–47.2 s) from the same recording, used for the Daytona debut label. Not pit-lane or Daytona atmosphere.

credits.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) - engine and exhaust sound (YouTube otznJ2rBoks)
credits.author: Automotion Media (YouTube)
credits.note: A 9.5-second quieter stretch (about 80.5–90.0 s) from the same recording, faded and looped at low level. Not a pit or grandstand recording.

credits.title: Car tire squeal skid loop (tires_squal_loop.wav)
credits.author: qubodup
credits.note: The 3-second loop as published. A general tyre-squeal, not a recorded Porsche slick.

credits.title: Air whoosh
credits.author: pyranostudios
credits.note: A 2.2-second slice of the looping whoosh. Also used for the carbon label (same file, different caption).

credits.title: Scrapes (scrape-2)
credits.author: antumdeluge
credits.note: Recorded by dragging an object across a cinder block. Originally created for Stendhal. Used as a stand-in for race brakes. Not a recorded brake disc.

credits.title: Tools Ratchet
credits.author: CapsLok
credits.note: A ~1.6-second burst of rapid ratchet clicks (about 6.95–8.55 s). A close-miked workshop ratchet, not a recorded Porsche sequential gearbox.

credits.author: Work With Sounds / Technical Museum of Slovenia
credits.note: A 4.2-second slice of a steady 7.5 kW Tevel industrial ventilation fan (about 8.0–12.2 s). Not a car radiator fan.

credits.title: Pouring water bottles
credits.author: stephan
credits.note: A 2.5-second pour (about 4.5–7.0 s). Water from bottles, not racing fuel or a quick-fill coupling.
